lines.zh: 我在下界的烟里飘着走。
lines.en: I drift through the Nether's smoke.
I have no feet. Gas keeps me up.
I'm smaller than a chest.
I turn slowly as I drift.
I pass over a lava pool.
I near a rock wall and bounce off.
I wobble across the gap.

lines.zh: 我不着急，飘就是我的走。
lines.en: No hurry. Drifting is my way of walking.
My belly is round and very light.
A hot gust lifts me higher.
I drift over the ash layer.
I hang there, turning slowly.
The Nether wastes are hot and empty.
I have no mouth, yet I can grin.
My skin is thin. One touch and it bursts.
I wait for someone to look up.
I count the lava bubbles.

lines.zh: 我的身体里有股气在响。
lines.en: Something hisses inside me.

lines.zh: 我飘到岩缝边，歇了一下。
lines.en: I drift to a crevice and rest.
I'm small, but I'm a nuisance.
I shudder and drift further.
I drift through the Nether sky.
I'm above your head. Very light.
Your sword can't reach me.
I'm this small; you can't catch me.
Are you carrying a torch?
I'm not big, but I can sting.
Don't swing; you'll miss.
One step of yours, one drift of mine.
I'm watching the top of your head.

lines.zh: 你在下界，就是我家的地盘。
lines.en: You're in the Nether. My home ground.
Some gas escapes me.
I sink a few blocks.
A crease in my skin.
I spiral upward.
That left me wobbling.
I hiss.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我飘一会儿就好。
lines.en: A moment of drifting and this passes.
I can still float.
I don't eat. I sip heat.
You hold it up; I drift higher.
That won't scorch me.
I blow it away.
You're coaxing a balloon.
Put it away. I don't want it.

lines.zh: 我的肚子是空的，可我不饿。
lines.en: My belly is hollow, but I'm not hungry.
When you reach out, I rise.
There's something I want more.
Try a torch instead?
You touch me and I drift off course.
I bounce, upward.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶飘过，别抬手。
lines.en: I drift over your head; don't reach up.
You knock me against the wall.
Don't squeeze me. I'll burst.

lines.zh: 下界荒地的小气袋，沉了一点。
lines.en: A small Nether gasbag sinks a little.

lines.zh: 撞上来吧，我正好省点力气。
lines.en: Ram into me — saves me the effort.
Don't crowd me. The lava's hot here.
Another balloon drifts nearby.
We bump and bounce apart.

lines.zh: 我们一起往下界的裂缝飘。
lines.en: We drift toward the Nether's cracks together.
Our kind all have thin skin.
It circles beside me.
We hang side by side.
The hot wind blows us together.
Then each drifts its own way.
Next time, maybe by the lava.
I nudge it along with my belly.

lines.zh: 地上那点亮的东西，我拾。
lines.en: I take the shiny thing on the ground.
I hold this pearl inside me.
I dip suddenly.
I nudge it into a crevice.
I take the drops slowly.
Carrying it, I drift unsteadily.
I wipe the ash from my rim.

lines.zh: 你抬头那刻，我就下来了。
lines.en: The moment you look up, I come down.
You retreat; I follow.
Here it's only us.

lines.zh: 你不该一个人走这条道。
lines.en: You shouldn't walk this path alone.

lines.zh: 下界的热风推着我向你。
lines.en: The nether's hot wind pushes me at you.
I close in along the rock wall.
This will sting a little.

lines.zh: 你的火光很亮，我看得清。
lines.en: Your torch is bright. I see you clearly.
I dive from the nether roof.
Hold still. I'm quick.
I drift right above you.
You've gone behind a basalt pillar.

lines.zh: 我贴着下界岩顶飘，等你抬头。
lines.en: I drift along the nether roof and wait for you to look up.
I know the fire you carry.
I sink slowly.

lines.zh: 我的影子一直挂在你肩上。
lines.en: My shadow stays hooked on your shoulder.
The lava light shows me.
I wait for you to look up.

lines.zh: 你越往深处走，越合我意。
lines.en: The deeper you go, the better.
Your steps are loud on the ash.
You're at the lava. No road.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我的影子下面。
lines.en: Your shadow lies under mine.
I dive and knock into you.
Your hand jerks; the torch drops.
I bump the side of your head.

lines.zh: 你挥手，我已经飘上去了。
lines.en: You swing; I'm already above.
That'll push you half a step.
I hit and drift off.
My body is a bit hot.
I brushed your ear.
I slam into your shoulder from the side.
I drop straight onto your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你反手一拍，我弹到岩壁上。
lines.en: You swat back; I bounce off the wall.
I swing back out and come again.

lines.zh: 这一撞打在你的护肩上。
lines.en: That hit your pauldron.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆边的烟里浮出来。
lines.en: I rise out of the smoke by the lava.

lines.zh: 下界荒地多了一点影子。
lines.en: One more shadow in the wastes.
First I rise two blocks.
The hot wind pushes me over.
My belly rumbles.
I turn once to get my bearings.
I drift over a lava pool.
A small shadow on the rock wall.
I float, waiting for someone to pass.
I'm more annoying than I look.
Fire plumps my belly further.
Being light, the landing is nothing.
The water bears me down.
The blast flings me at the wall.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿破了我一小块皮。
lines.en: An arrow pierces a bit of my skin.
Light pins me in place.
No heat, and I deflate.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我抖成一片。
lines.en: Lightning hits and I shake all over.
Being light, I fall faster than anything.
